name: Magic Cats Pots
description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!


Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!
